title: Towards Transparent Reasoning: What Drives Faithfulness in Large Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the faithfulness of model explanations using the BBQ dataset, which contains stereotype-sensitive scenarios involving individuals from discriminated groups. The authors employ the 'Causal Concept Faithfulness' metric, which generates counterfactuals by perturbing high-level concepts (e.g., demographic attributes) and measures the correlation between the causal effect of these concepts on the model's predictions and the effect implied by the generated explanations.
